findings.claim: The declared objective is final predicted target affinity as primary, with validity and strain secondary and coordinate control only; the reward view is the endpoint pointcloud with a detached FLOWR endpoint VJP, so coordinate contrasts are not physical interaction energies.

The observed window is the score-time interval [0.0, 0.5] with 50 observed score nodes at 0.01 spacing, and the curve support is [0.0, 0.49]; recorded affinities are removed and an equal score prior is used, so no decoded terminal affinity labels are available for this study.

Continuous contrast functions over the observed support are non-monotone: landmark_00_soft_mass shows 4 sign changes with first_rate_z positive and last_rate_z negative, and landmark_00_local_dy shows 6 sign changes with a large negative first_rate_z and positive last_rate_z, so a constant rule is not supported and a time-conditioned rule is indicated.

Several landmark_00 local contrast features carry strong sign conflicts (e.g. 9 for local_dx, 7 for local_dz, 4 for local_dy) and no polynomial fit is accepted, so the observed-node linear representation is the only validated description and extrapolation beyond the observed support is not allowed.

hypotheses.falsifier: A constant rule matching or exceeding the observed-node fit fidelity of the time-conditioned rule on held-out observed nodes.
hypotheses.observable: landmark_00_soft_mass and landmark_00_local_dy observed-node contrast values over score times [0.0, 0.49]
hypotheses.scope: observed score window only; no extrapolation
hypotheses.statement: A time-conditioned coordinate contrast rule that follows the observed-node sign of landmark_00_soft_mass and landmark_00_local_dy across the observed window will track the observed contrast better than a constant rule, because both features show multiple sign changes with opposite first and last rate signs.

hypotheses.direction: joint pattern requires separate coupling evidence
hypotheses.falsifier: Joint diagnostics showing coherent coupling consistent with the marginal descriptors.
hypotheses.observable: joint_diagnostics metrics versus isolated marginal continuous_trends features
hypotheses.statement: Isolated marginal landmark_00 local descriptors are not sufficient evidence of a coherent joint coordinate pattern, because the supplied continuous trends show strong sign conflicts and no accepted polynomial, so joint coupling must be tested against the joint diagnostics before being treated as a target.

limitations: No decoded terminal affinity labels are supplied; last-record or survival credit cannot be presented as final affinity benefit.
No current study outcome data are available to the Analyst, so no causal selection effect or atom-velocity interpretation is supported.
Continuous contrast curves are coordinate contrasts, not absolute reward targets or physical interaction energies.
Only the first six continuous_trends rows were read; the remaining 194 rows and the other tables were not inspected in this turn.
